newsitem.title: USA: FLORIDA SMOKERS TRIAL PUSHED BACK TO DEC OR LATER.
newsitem.headline: FLORIDA SMOKERS TRIAL PUSHED BACK TO DEC OR LATER.

text.p: A class-action lawsuit on behalf of ailing smokers in Florida will not begin on Sept 8 as scheduled and is likely to be pushed back to December or early 1998, a court official said Wednesday.
Dade County Judge Alan Postman and rival lawyers all agreed that a delay was needed.

Many pre-trial issues have yet to be resolved and Stanley and Susan Rosenblatt, the lawyers pressing the suit on behalf of smokers in Florida claiming addiction to cigarettes, are involved with a $5 billion secondhand-smoke case that is unlikely to end before late September, the court official said.
Postman has proposed a Jan 20 starting date, while the Rosenblatts have suggested a December start and lawyers defending tobacco companies asked for a Feb 2 trial beginning.
